messages:
alex: kicking off intake for kite-13b-int8-fast perf bench — want a tight preflight and explicit pass/fail before we run full ctx/batch sweep. target pool: `v100-32g-bench-2026-07`

rachel: noted. quick preflight checklist: 
- model: `kite-13b-int8-fast.v1`
- baseline: `kite-13b-fp16.v4`
- pools: v100-32g-bench-2026-07 (prefer 80g if available)
- ctx points: 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048
- batch sizes: 1,2,4,8,16
- kernel modes: `auto`, `ctx-optimized`
- runs: cold x2, warm x15, steady-state iters 25
- metrics: median, p95 (ms), tok/s, tok/s per GPU, GPU mem peak, % time in kernel X, KV-prefill iterations
- QA: 150-sample greedy compare -> mean KL & top-1 mismatch list

sam: pass/fail proposal: 
- median <= 95ms @ batch=1 ctx=128
- p95 <= 250ms @ batch=1 ctx=128
- throughput scale >=1.6x when batch 1->2 for ctx<=512
- efficiency loss <=20% at batch=16 vs batch=1
- no OOMs for ctx<=1024 at batch<=8
- quality: mean KL <0.02 and top-1 mismatch <=3%

bench-bot: Reservation requested: `v100-32g-bench-2026-07` (3 nodes) until 2026-07-12T06:00:00Z. Requestor: alex. Status: pending.

infra-bot: Reservation approved: v100-32g-bench-2026-07 (3 nodes) until 2026-07-12T06:00:00Z. Billing: ENG-ML-BENCH.

rachel: bench harness command (example):

```
python -m bench.run \
  --model kite-13b-int8-fast.v1 \
  --baseline kite-13b-fp16.v4 \
  --device cuda \
  --pools v100-32g-bench-2026-07 \
  --ctx 128,256,512,1024,2048 \
  --batch 1,2,4,8,16 \
  --kernels auto,ctx-optimized \
  --warmup 15 \
  --iters 30 \
  --trace perf_trace.json
```

rachel: KV warmup probe (measure prefills to steady state):

```
python -m bench.kv_probe --model kite-13b-int8-fast.v1 --prefix 512 --iters 30 --out kv_prefill.json
```

alex: starting cold-check now (root ts 1943210102). will post numbers.

alex: cold run (1943210199): median 420ms, p95 1.15s, tok/s 78 @ batch=1 ctx=128.

sam: cold numbers look typical. run warm sequence and record steady-state after ~10 iters.

alex: warm steady results (1943210543): median 92ms, p95 230ms, tok/s 245, GPU mem peak 14.8GB, no OOMs. KV prefills: steady at ~6 iterations for prefix 512.

qa-bot: kicking off quality run (150 samples) against fp16 baseline. will output `kl_report.csv` and `mismatch_samples.tgz`.

qa-bot: quality run complete (1943210899): mean KL=0.013, top-1 mismatch=1.8% (3 samples flagged). uploading artifacts.

alex: uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-ml/bench/kite/1943210000/ (perf_trace.json, kv_prefill.json, kl_report.csv, run_meta.json).

rachel: quick summary: perf gates PASS for ctx<=512. ctx=1024 batch=8 approaches VRAM limit on v100-32g (peak ~31GB); recommend running 1024/8 on 80g or try `ctx-optimized` kernels. KL looks good, 3 flagged for manual eval.

sam: action items:
- infra: schedule a follow-up 1024/8 run on 80g or with `--kernels ctx-optimized`
- eval-team: manual review of 3 flagged mismatch samples and overall 150-sample report
- bench-team: add KV warmup note (~6) to onboarding ticket
